results.name: One bounded adapter exposes all ten state catalogs while layouts have shared physical owners
Native column-major room records project into row-major editor cells without transposing their coordinates
Native block quadrants and small tiles preserve column order; palettes retain NES row quadrant order
Both resource pages preserve all 256 source rows including the final sixteen-pixel fragment
An edit changes only its original physical column-major byte, including native block IDs above 127
Unchanged native output is byte identical and returns independent bytes
Malformed, stale-layout, duplicate and out-of-bounds recipes refuse before source mutation
Unresolved room slots remain explicitly unavailable and cannot be materialized
Malformed pointer, palette and graphics bounds refuse instead of constructing guessed assets
Existing codecs and profiles retain their exact order, identity and behavior
A familiar filename or synthetic format cannot activate the exact-revision adapter
